steps.en: Short verb ending in one vowel + consonant: double the last letter, then -ed.
steps.hi: एक स्वर + व्यंजन पर ख़त्म होने वाली छोटी क्रिया: आख़िरी अक्षर दोगुना करके -ed।

intro.en: The simple past tense tells about actions that happened and finished in the past: "I played yesterday." Regular verbs add -ed (walk → walked). Irregular verbs change form (go → went, eat → ate).
intro.hi: Simple past tense बीते समय में हुए और पूरे हो चुके कामों के बारे में बताता है: "I played yesterday." Regular क्रियाओं में -ed लगता है (walk → walked)। Irregular क्रियाओं का रूप बदलता है (go → went, eat → ate)।
